payment.title: Paiman
payment.cardReconHelp: Skrifi abra san de na tapu a bon fu a bank-terminal — so wi man vergelijk den PIN-seri fu a dei nanga a bankafschrift. Yu no abi fu du en.
payment.cardBankCustomPlaceholder: Nen fu a bank noso merk
payment.terminalWaiting: E wakti a PIN-terminal — a klanti e pai…
payment.terminalApproved: A terminal gi okay — den gegevens skrifi kaba
payment.transferHelp: A seri e skrifi leki 'e wakti tapu bevestiging'. A beheerder fu yu o marki en leki pai, te a moni doro na a bankrekening.
payment.transferBank: Bank di e kisi a moni
payment.transferSenderName: Nen fu a sma di pai
payment.foreignCashHelp: A klanti e pai nanga USD noso EUR. Wi e hori a koers fu tide, èn a bon e sori den tu bedrag.
payment.qrWalletHelp: A klanti e scan a QR-code fu a wenkri, dan a e pai ini a wallet-app. Te a wallet-apparaat sori taki a paiman kisi, dan yu e klari en.
payment.qrScanInstruction: Scan nanga a wallet-app èn poti a bedrag disi:
payment.qrNoImage: No {{wallet}}-QR seti gi a wenkri disi. Upload en na Dashboard → Vestigingen → Instellingen → QR-wallets — noso meki a klanti scan a QR-sticker na a kassa.
payment.walletConfirmed: Paiman kisi — bevestig na tapu a wallet-apparaat
payment.walletPendingNote: No bevestig ete: a seri e skrifi leki 'e wakti tapu bevestiging' èn a beheerder fu yu mu gi okay later.

serverConfig.title: Server-adres
serverConfig.overrideActive: Wan eigen adres seti na a kassa disi — a e teki a presi fu a standaard adres.
serverConfig.hint: Kenki disi soso na installatie noso te a wenkri-server kisi wan nyun adres. Efu yu no de seiker, aksi yu manager — a app e start baka te yu kibri en.
serverConfig.findUnavailable: A suku na a netwerk e wroko soso na ini a kassa-app di seti na a computer. Na ini wan browser yu musu tayp a adres.
serverConfig.searching: E suku na a lokaal netwerk…
serverConfig.foundOne: Wan server feni na a netwerk — kontroleer na ondro.
serverConfig.foundMany: {{n}} server feni na a netwerk. Teki a wan fu a wenkri disi:
serverConfig.foundNone: No wan server feni na a netwerk disi. Luku efu a kassa de na a wenkri-netwerk (kabel noso a wifi fu a wenkri), aksi yu manager gi a server-adres, noso tayp a adres nanga anu efu a server de na wan tra presi.

blindReturn.title: Retour sondro bon
blindReturn.intro: Meki a baskita fu now tron wan retour sondro wan fosi seri. Ibri regel e drai baka èn a voorraad e kon baka. Manager-wroko — a e skrifi ini a audit trail.
blindReturn.refundVia: Fa a moni e go baka
blindReturn.reasonPlaceholder: Bijv. klanti tyari a sani kon baka sondro bon
blindReturn.done: A retour skrifi kaba — SRD {{total}} gi baka

cameraScan.title: Scan nanga camera
cameraScan.hint: Hori a camera na tapu a barcode
cameraScan.httpsOnly: Camera-scan e wroko soso nanga wan beveiligde verbinding (HTTPS) noso ini a desktop-app. Gebruik wan USB-barcodescanner noso tik a barcode ini a suku-veld.
cameraScan.denied: A camera no kisi permissie — gi a camera permissie èn pruberi baka.
cameraScan.failed: A camera no man opo. Gebruik wan USB-scanner noso tik a barcode. ({{error}})

labels.noPrintersFound: No wan printer feni — luku a printer-verbinding ini Windows
labels.printerHint: Den printer di de e sori ini a print-venster. Test a bonprinter ini Seti → Printer & Kassalade.

btwExempt.title: BTW-fri (vrijstelling)
btwExempt.explain: A bayman no e pai BTW — a prijs e saka go na a moni sondro BTW. Yu musu skrifi fu san ede; a e kon na tapu a bon nanga den Belastingdienst-rapport.
btwExempt.reasonTooShort: Skrifi pikinmoro 5 letter — disi e go na a Belastingdienst.

endOfDay.confirmSubmit: Yu de seiker taki yu wani seni den gegevens fu tide?
endOfDay.submitSuccess: Den gegevens fu a dei seni bun

exchangeRate.title: USD → SRD Wisselkoers
exchangeRate.manualOverrideHint: Poti a koers fu tide yusrefi. Disi e teki a presi fu a koers di kon automatisch.
exchangeRate.noRate: No koers seti ete gi tide.

printer.title: Printer & Kassalade
printer.pinHelp: Gebruik Pin 2 gi moro furu kassalade. Pruberi Pin 5 efu a lade no e opo.
printer.paperWidthHelp: A bradi mu de a srefi leki a papira-rol: 80 mm gi toonbank-printer (EPSON TM-T20 sortu), 58 mm gi pikin printer. Efu a bradi fowtu, den regel e broko noso pisi e lasi.
printer.helpElectron:
Netwerk (TCP): koppel a printer na a LAN èn poti en IP-adres. Wi e rai en gi EPSON TM-T20 nanga Ethernet.
USB: teki a printer soleki fa a sori ini Windows Apparaten.
printer.helpAndroid:
Netwerk (TCP): poti a IP-adres fu a printer — na Android a bonprinter musu de na a netwerk; printer di abi soso USB no e wroko.
Etiket nanga testpagina e printi nanga a Android-printvenster.
printer.autoPrint: Prenti a bon automatisch baka ibri seri
printer.autoPrintHelp: Wan bon-printer e prenti safri sondro aksi; sondro printer a print-venster e opo baka ibri seri.
printer.networkOnlyHint: USB print e wroko soso na a Windows-app — na tapu a masyin disi gebroiki wan netwerk printer (en IP-adres).
printer.share: Prati a printer disi na tapu a netwerk
printer.shareShareHelp: Android-kasa e print pasa a pc disi. Poti a adres disi na ibri kasa (Instellingen → Hardware → Netwerk):
printer.shareShareNote: A pc disi musu tan na tapu so den tra kasa man print. Soso Windows-app.
printer.shareShareFailed: A prati no man bigin — luku efu no wan tra programa e gebroiki poort 9100.
printer.usbHelp: Poti a printer na a terminal, dan fasi na ondro èn teki en. Android e aksi wan leisi fu primisi.
printer.usbNoHost: A terminal disi no abi wan USB-host-poort — a no man tai wan printer leti. Teki wan netwerk-printer, noso a printer-broko tapu wan Windows-kassa.
printer.usbUnavailable: USB-printi abi a Android-app fanowdu (versi 1.4.1 noso moro nyun). Installeri a moro nyun APK baka fu a downloadpagina.
printer.usbNone: No wan USB-sani feni. Luku a kabel èn efu a printer de na tapu.
printer.usbDenied: A USB-primisi weigri — fasi baka tapu Tai èn gi primisi.

system.subtitle: Josbin POS · v{{version}}
system.confirmRestartBody: A app o tapu èn opo baka. Yu no abi fu log in baka.
system.confirmQuitBody: A app o tapu heri-heri. Fu opo en baka: start en fu a bureaublad noso a Start-menu.
system.blockCart: A baskita abi {{count}} sani ete. Klari a seri noso kibri en fosi yu tapu.
system.blockSync: {{count}} dei fu Z-Report no seni ete na a hoofdkantoor. Seni den fosi, so yu no e lasi gegevens.
system.warnRegisterOpen: A kassa-sessie opo ete. Yu man tapu now, ma tapu a kassa te a dienst e kaba.
system.autoLaunch: Start Josbin POS automatisch te yu e opo a kassa disi
system.autoLaunchHelp: Wi e rai en gi POS-kassa — a kassier no abi fu opo a app moro te a computer e opo.

weighed.title: Sani di wegi / weegschaal-barcode
weighed.modePrice: Prijs (a weegschaal poti a prijs kaba)
weighed.help: Weegschaal e prenti wan EAN-13 nanga prefix 2, di abi wan artikel-code + prijs noso gewicht ini en. Standaard indeling: 2 + 6 cijfer artikel-code + 5 cijfer waarde + controle-cijfer. Luku bun nanga yu eigen weegschaal fosi yu bigin — wan fowtu indeling e gi fowtu prijs na sani di wegi.

cardTerminal.title: PIN-terminal (karta-paiman)
cardTerminal.help: Fa a PIN-terminal fasi na a kassa disi. Standaard a de aparte (so den e du en na Sranan): yu e tik a bedrag yusrefi na a bank-apparaat èn yu e skrifi abra a bon. A gesimuleerde terminal na fu training nanga demo. Wan directe koppeling (ECR) abi a terminal-protocol fu yu bank fanowdu — bel ITSea te yu bank e gi en.

auth.locked: A account sroto. Taki nanga yu beheerder.
auth.sessionExpired: Yu sessie kaba. Log in baka.
